verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a live event debugger, per-destination delivery metrics or error views, or alerting on delivery failures. The nearest items are bare page titles about data quality and forwarding, plus a development/production environment flag. None of these describes observability of event flow, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting
